source.description_nl: De stikstofgevoelige habitattypen binnen een Natura 2000-gebied die ook daadwerkelijk relevant zijn bevonden voor AERIUS
source.version: As served on the fetch date. The service does not state a version; the catalogue record (see 'record') says which AERIUS release the layer belongs to.
source.licence: Public domain (Creative Commons Public Domain Mark 1.0), no restrictions, per the Nationaal Georegister record

notes: Habitat types are the ones AERIUS marks as relevant (nitrogen-sensitive) for a location.
kdw_mol_per_ha is the critical deposition value (kritische depositiewaarde) as given by AERIUS, in mol N per ha per year.
No comparison is made here between the KDW and the RIVM deposition map.

mapped_ha is the area of the mapped polygons; coverage_weighted_ha multiplies the mapped area of a habitat type by the one coverage AERIUS gives for that type in the whole Natura 2000 area, so for a part of the area it is an approximation.
Map area: the bounding box of Nijkerk plus 15 km. Areas are computed on the unsimplified data.
Drawn shapes: all relevant habitat types of an area merged, parts under 1 ha left out, holes under 2 ha filled, simplified to 100 m. For display only.
Codes: H = habitat type; ZGH = search area (indications, but no certainty, that the habitat type is present); Lg = nitrogen-sensitive habitat of Birds and Habitats Directive species (leefgebied).
service_reply lists every Natura 2000 area the service returned for the bounding box; the query is by location, not by area name.
What 'relevant' means, the KDW threshold and the code L4030: see docs/nitrogen-sources.md, 'AERIUS definitions: verification'.
